title: Author the library build-type template
description: Create templates/library/template.json (valid against template.schema.json, required_files listed) and templates/library/files/: package.json (name {{slug}}, main src/index.js, no bin, test script), README.md, .gitignore, src/index.js exporting a sample function, test/index.test.js exercising it. Only {{slug}}/{{summary}} placeholders; only node: built-ins. A test renders the template into a temp project and asserts required_files are produced and the report validates.
acceptance_criteria: templates/library/template.json validates against template.schema.json and lists its required_files.
Scaffolding build_type=library renders the files/ tree with {{slug}}/{{summary}} substituted and writes a valid scaffold-report.json.
The rendered test/index.test.js passes under node --test; a framework test covers the render; full suite passes.
